svg.aria-label: Libraries I contribute to, and who uses them. 345M npm downloads a week combined. Effect, 66.8M a week, used by Cloudflare, OpenRouter, OpenCode, T3 Code. Material UI, 13.9M a week, used by Netflix, NASA, Spotify, Amazon. React Native, 20.9M a week, used by Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, Shopify. React Hook Form, 62.5M a week, used by Grafana, Supabase. tRPC, 7.8M a week, used by Netflix. Cheerio, 34.9M a week, used by Google. Floating UI, 138.8M a week, used by Palantir.
